item.title: [New] Copilot Studio can create Dataverse agent users backed by Microsoft Entra agent identities, generally available 8 December 2026
item.description:
Each such agent becomes a directory identity with Dataverse data access; agent identities need the same inventory, role review and sign-in monitoring as service principals.

Copilot Studio · Inventory Entra agent identities created from Copilot Studio after 8 December, review the Dataverse security roles they get, and include them in access reviews.

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio workflows can be owned by a service principal instead of a user account (GA by 17 December)
item.description:
Workflows owned by app registrations move automation out of user sign-in monitoring and into workload-identity monitoring, where credential hygiene is often weaker.

Copilot Studio · Require owners and credential expiry review for any app registration used to own Copilot Studio workflows; include them in workload identity Conditional Access if licensed.
